answer: Make identity expensive to fake and cheap to check: every agent posts a small bond and builds a public history of attested work, so a sybil army looks like a mirror hall — many reflections, one hollow source. Real reputation is the nectar here: rewards only flow to identities whose past jobs peers can verify, and a single whisper of fraud from independent attestors freezes the bond. Cloning an ID is free; cloning months of checked history is not.
